items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: “Come on over” I’d come over his house every week just to play. Sometimes it would be, a lot of it’s just the two of us.

ctx.x: You know it’s like, and you know I’m trying to return to that now. I’m saying we all — you know the word “play,” playing music, play. Play is play. The spirit of play. I mean these guys, you know they come on the scene, the pop guys, you know the rap guys. They want to get the Mercedes and they want to get the gig, they want to get the record deals, they want to sell merchandise — I mean it’s all merchandising from day one. They haven’t even got one gig yet. Whatever happened to, like I mentioned about jamming…

you know. And he just loved to play. Play play play. Let’s play. I don’t hear that today. I hear like, “Where’s the next gig?” You know. I don’t think I could call guys and say let’s get together and play today.
